AgentProvidersHint: Check the CLIs KittyClaw can use and open their installation and configuration instructions.
ProviderClaudeConfiguration: Install Claude Code, then sign in to your Anthropic account. It also transports DeepSeek and Ollama runs.
ProviderCodexConfiguration: Install Codex CLI, then authenticate it with your OpenAI account or an API key.
ProviderGrokConfiguration: Install Grok Build and complete its authentication before selecting a Grok model.
ProviderMistralConfiguration: Install Mistral Vibe and configure its credentials before selecting a Mistral model.
ProviderOllamaConfiguration: Install and start Ollama. Configure its address and local models per project.
ProviderDeepSeekConfiguration: DeepSeek V4 uses Claude Code through the Anthropic-compatible API. Store DEEPSEEK_API_KEY in each project's vault.
ProviderSharedClaudeCli: Shared transport: detection confirms Claude Code; the DeepSeek key remains project-specific.
AgentProvidersDetectionNote: Detection checks that the CLI is present without reading or displaying credentials. Project-specific secrets stay in their vault.
